tools.name: add_link
tools.description: Add a web link (http or https URL, optional title) to a task (capture level). Returns link_id.

command_id.description: Idempotency key (UUID). Reuse it, with the same arguments, only to retry this exact write.

title.description: Display title. Default: none (the URL is shown).

tools.name: add_note
tools.description: Append text to a task's notes (capture level).

command_id.description: Idempotency key (UUID). Reuse it, with the same arguments, only to retry this exact write.

text.description: Text to append (on a new paragraph).

tools.name: add_reminder
tools.description: Add a reminder to a task at a given time (plan level). at is an RFC 3339 time with an offset, or a local time (2030-01-02T09:00) in the owner's time zone. Returns reminder_id.

at.description:
When to remind: an RFC 3339 time with an offset (`2030-01-02T09:00:00Z`,
`2030-01-02T09:00:00+01:00`), or a local time without one (`2030-01-02T09:00`), read in the
owner's time zone.

command_id.description: Idempotency key (UUID). Reuse it, with the same arguments, only to retry this exact write.

tools.name: add_step
tools.description: Add a checklist step to a task (plan level). Returns step_id.

PositionArg.description: Where to put an item among its siblings.

command_id.description: Idempotency key (UUID). Reuse it, with the same arguments, only to retry this exact write.

position.description: Where among the task's steps. Default last.

tools.name: archive_task
tools.description: Delete a task, softly (plan level). There is no separate archived state: this is the same delete as in the app. The task, its steps, links and reminders leave every list and query; get_task still finds it with include_deleted: true, and nothing is erased. The only way back is undo_event on this result's event (or the owner restoring it).

command_id.description: Idempotency key (UUID). Reuse it, with the same arguments, only to retry this exact write.

tools.name: complete_task
tools.description: Complete a task, or reopen (uncomplete) it with completed: false (plan level). Completing a repeating task creates its next occurrence.

command_id.description: Idempotency key (UUID). Reuse it, with the same arguments, only to retry this exact write.

completed.description: `true` (default) completes it; a repeating task then gets its next occurrence. `false` reopens it.

tools.name: create_tag
tools.description: Create a tag (needs plan level on at least one existing list and a default level of at least read). Returns tag_id. Check list_tags first: names are unique. Renaming and deleting tags is the owner's.

command_id.description: Idempotency key (UUID). Reuse it, with the same arguments, only to retry this exact write.

name.description: Name, unique among tags (case-insensitively), for example `work`.

tools.name: create_task
tools.description: Create a task (capture level; plan level to make it repeat). Goes to the Inbox unless list_id is given. Optional due date, start date, open status, priority and repeat rule (which needs a due date). Returns task_id and the event. Query first to avoid duplicates; retry with the same command_id.

RecurrenceArg.description:
A repeat rule, the same shape `get_task` returns as `recurrence`. The task must have a due date:
completing it creates the next occurrence, due on the next date the rule gives after the completed
task's due date. Example: `{"rule": {"freq": "monthly", "day": 1}, "until": "2031-12-31"}`.

rule.description:
The repeat pattern, tagged by `freq`: `daily`, `weekly` (needs `days`), `monthly` (needs
`day`) or `yearly`.

until.description: Last date, `YYYY-MM-DD` (inclusive), on which an occurrence may fall. Omit to repeat forever.

RuleArg.description:
How often a task repeats. `interval` is 1–999 (default 1): `{"freq": "weekly", "interval": 2,
"days": ["mon"]}` is every other Monday.

oneOf.description: Every `interval` weeks, on the given weekdays (weeks start on Monday).

days.description: The weekdays it falls on; at least one.

oneOf.description: Every `interval` months on a day of the month (1–31; shorter months use their last day).
Every `interval` years on the due date's month and day (29 February becomes 28 February).

command_id.description: Idempotency key (UUID). Reuse it, with the same arguments, only to retry this exact write.

list_id.description:
The list to create it in. Omit to use the Inbox (the list named "Inbox" that you can capture
into).

recurrence.description: Make it repeat (needs `due`, and plan level on the list). Default: it doesn't repeat.

start_date.description: Start date, `YYYY-MM-DD`; must be on or before `due` when both are set.

tools.name: get_activity
tools.description: Recent changes, newest first, with one-line summaries, who made them and whether they can be undone. Only changes in lists you can see. Paginated: pass next_before back as before.

before.description: Only events with `seq` below this (the previous page's `next_before`). Default: the newest.

tools.name: get_task
tools.description: Get one task with its workflow status (including Done), start date, steps, links, attachments, reminders and tags.

include_deleted.description: Also return it (and its steps) when deleted. Default false.

tools.name: list_collections
tools.description: List the collections (groups of lists) you can see, in display order. Paginated: pass next_cursor back as cursor.

cursor.description: `next_cursor` from the previous page; omit for the first page.

include_deleted.description: Also return deleted (archived) items. Default false.

tools.name: list_lists
tools.description: List the lists you can see, with IDs, collections and features (workflow, timeline, default_view), in display order. Paginated: pass next_cursor back as cursor.

cursor.description: `next_cursor` from the previous page; omit for the first page.

include_deleted.description: Also return deleted (archived) items. Default false.

tools.name: list_tags
tools.description: List the tags you can see (with their IDs, names and colors). Without a default level of read you see only the tags on tasks you can read. Paginated: pass next_cursor back as cursor.

cursor.description: `next_cursor` from the previous page; omit for the first page.

include_deleted.description: Also return deleted (archived) items. Default false.

tools.name: merge_tasks
tools.description: Merge a duplicate task (source) into the one to keep (target) (plan level on both). The source's steps, links, attachments, tags and notes move over and the source is deleted.

command_id.description: Idempotency key (UUID). Reuse it, with the same arguments, only to retry this exact write.

source_task_id.description:
The duplicate. Its steps, links, attachments, tags and notes move to the target, and it is
deleted.

tools.name: move_task
tools.description: Move a task to another list (plan level on both lists).

PositionArg.description: Where to put an item among its siblings.

command_id.description: Idempotency key (UUID). Reuse it, with the same arguments, only to retry this exact write.

from_list.description: Expected source list ID. If supplied, refuse the move if the task was moved or merged.

position.description: Where in the destination list. Default last.

tools.name: query_tasks
tools.description: Find tasks with a smart-list query (see the query argument), across the lists you can see. Use it before create_task to avoid duplicates. Paginated: pass next_cursor back as cursor with the same query.

cursor.description: `next_cursor` from the previous page of the same query; omit for the first page.

query.description:
Query in the smart-list language, for example `list:inbox and not done`, `due<=today sort:due`,
`status:in_progress start<=today sort:start`, `priority>=high tag:work`, `my_day`, or free
words matched against titles, notes and steps (`milk`). Empty matches every live task.
At most 1024 bytes, 64 nodes and 32 terms.

tools.name: set_my_day
tools.description: Put a task in My Day (today by default) or take it out with in_my_day: false (plan level).

command_id.description: Idempotency key (UUID). Reuse it, with the same arguments, only to retry this exact write.

date.description: The day, `YYYY-MM-DD`. Default: today in the owner's time zone. Ignored when removing.

in_my_day.description: `true` (default) adds it to My Day, `false` removes it.

tools.name: tag_task
tools.description: Put a tag on a task (plan level). Get tag IDs from list_tags. Tagging a task that already has the tag changes nothing.

command_id.description: Idempotency key (UUID). Reuse it, with the same arguments, only to retry this exact write.

tools.name: undo_event
tools.description: Undo one of your own changes by the seq and id of any of its events (undoing an undo redoes it). Refused with undo_conflict if later changes touched the same fields; look at them before retrying with force: true.

command_id.description: Idempotency key (UUID). Reuse it, with the same arguments, only to retry this exact undo.

epoch.description:
The `epoch` of the result or feed you took the event from. If the list has been restored
since, the undo is refused with `epoch_mismatch`. Optional but recommended.

event_id.description:
The `id` of that same event, as given next to its `seq`. If another event has that `seq` (the
list was restored from a backup since), the undo is refused with `event_mismatch` instead of
undoing the wrong change.

force.description:
Undo even though later changes touched the same fields (only after an `undo_conflict` you have
looked at). Default false.

seq.description:
`seq` of any event of the change (from a write result or `get_activity`). Undoing an undo
redoes the change.

tools.name: untag_task
tools.description: Take a tag off a task (plan level). The tag itself stays. Untagging a task that doesn't have the tag changes nothing. If that was the last task through which you saw the tag, a retry gets not_found: confirm with get_task on the task instead.

command_id.description: Idempotency key (UUID). Reuse it, with the same arguments, only to retry this exact write.

tools.name: update_reminder
tools.description: Move a reminder to another time (plan level). at takes the same forms as in add_reminder.

at.description: The new time, in the same forms as `add_reminder`'s `at`.

command_id.description: Idempotency key (UUID). Reuse it, with the same arguments, only to retry this exact write.

tools.name: update_step
tools.description: Retitle a step and/or tick it off (completed: true) or reopen it (completed: false) (plan level).

command_id.description: Idempotency key (UUID). Reuse it, with the same arguments, only to retry this exact write.

completed.description: `true` ticks the step off, `false` reopens it.

tools.name: update_task
tools.description: Change a task's title, notes, open status, start date, due date, priority or repeat rule (plan level). Omitted fields stay as they are, except that a one-date edit can shift the other date to keep start on or before due. Null clears start_date, due or recurrence; a repeat rule needs a due date. Use complete_task for Done.

RecurrenceArg.description:
A repeat rule, the same shape `get_task` returns as `recurrence`. The task must have a due date:
completing it creates the next occurrence, due on the next date the rule gives after the completed
task's due date. Example: `{"rule": {"freq": "monthly", "day": 1}, "until": "2031-12-31"}`.

rule.description:
The repeat pattern, tagged by `freq`: `daily`, `weekly` (needs `days`), `monthly` (needs
`day`) or `yearly`.

until.description: Last date, `YYYY-MM-DD` (inclusive), on which an occurrence may fall. Omit to repeat forever.

RuleArg.description:
How often a task repeats. `interval` is 1–999 (default 1): `{"freq": "weekly", "interval": 2,
"days": ["mon"]}` is every other Monday.

oneOf.description: Every `interval` weeks, on the given weekdays (weeks start on Monday).

days.description: The weekdays it falls on; at least one.

oneOf.description: Every `interval` months on a day of the month (1–31; shorter months use their last day).
Every `interval` years on the due date's month and day (29 February becomes 28 February).

command_id.description: Idempotency key (UUID). Reuse it, with the same arguments, only to retry this exact write.

due.description: New due date `YYYY-MM-DD`, or `null` to clear it.

notes.description: New notes, replacing the old ones (use `add_note` to append instead).

recurrence.description:
New repeat rule, replacing the old one, or `null` to stop repeating. The task must have a due
date (its current one, or `due` in the same call).

start_date.description:
Start date, `YYYY-MM-DD`, or `null` to clear. Editing only one date can shift the other
to keep start on or before due. When supplying both, give a valid span.

status.description: Open stage: `backlog`, `todo`, or `in_progress`. Use `complete_task` for Done.
